scope: Selected-case computation; no calibration or public spatial inference.

raw_diagnostics.criteria: At least 2 chains; Rhat <= 1.01; bulk/tail ESS >= 100 per chain; no divergences or depth hits; E-BFMI >= 0.3.

historical_comparison_note: Laplace CDFs are retained historical outputs; old thresholds were serialized to 12 digits. They were not recomputed at the parsed rounded values. New independent runs use identical stored thresholds.
